name: @browserid-ng/gate
description: Publish stdio MCP servers as remote, BrowserID-gated HTTP endpoints. One command runs the gateway + web console (npx @browserid-ng/gate --admin you@example.com): add servers by name + mount + command, grant access with roles — per person, per server, per tool. Every call is scoped, attributed, and revocable. Works without a tunnel (localhost); claims a tailscale funnel automatically when available.
